repaired_in_continuation.domain: B2/B10 verifier routing for deterministic local actions (R6)
repaired_in_continuation.root_gap: The Fabric spine re-derived a deterministic local action's effect itself (MATCH), but the mission's independent verifier step for that step was dispatched to a worker role, so a model was asked to judge what the runtime can recompute; with a bounded local worker substitute the verdict was FAIL ('model PASS is not backed by a JARVIS-owned artifact predicate') and the mission ended BLOCKED with no false success.
repaired_in_continuation.repair: fabric/loop.canonical_predicate_verdict reuses the predicate the spine applies to the action; fabric/adapter.canonical_verifier_dispatch answers a verifier session by re-running it over the step's recorded fabric.spine.result receipt (declining when there is no receipt, the predicate is undecided, or the recorded subject diverged); mission/loop accepts the re-derived predicate as the artifact predicate the acceptance rule demands and records who answered the verification.
repaired_in_continuation.acceptance: VERIFIER_ROUTING_REPAIR_PROOF.json (A/B: seam patched out = BLOCKED with the predicate refusal, seam present = PASSED with the canonical predicate); SELF_EXPANSION_PROOF.json 9/9; verifier-routing tests 6/6

repaired_in_continuation.root_gap: A verification pass resumed after the frozen binding drifted could not re-freeze a different binding under the same content-addressed verdict identity, so the ledger raised EventConflict and the exception escaped MissionLoop.  verifier_binding.py is byte-identical to the lane base, so this was pre-existing.
repaired_in_continuation.repair: mission/loop catches the ledger's refusal at the capture site and refuses honestly: BLOCKED verdict with the ledger's own reason, mission BLOCKED, resume left to a fresh attempt. No identity derivation, gate check or shared signature changed.
repaired_in_continuation.acceptance: VERIFIER_ROUTING_REPAIR_PROOF.json (before: unhandled EventConflict; after: BLOCKED 'the frozen verification binding changed while a verification pass was open')
